en.meta.title: FHV Insurance Certificate Upload Guide
en.page.title: How to upload your FHV Insurance Certificate
en.page.intro: Having trouble with the FHV Insurance Certificate step in the app? Follow the steps below — each numbered marker on the screenshots shows exactly what to tap or fill in.
en.step1.title: Go to the Vehicles section
en.step1.body: In the registration app, open the Vehicles section and scroll down to FHV Insurance Certificate.
en.step2.title: Fill in the FHV Insurance Certificate details
en.step2.body: Follow the numbered markers below in order to complete this section.
en.legend.upload: Tap here to upload a clear photo of your FHV insurance certificate.
en.legend.docnum: Type your Policy Number here — it goes in the Document Number field.
en.legend.expiry: Select the expiration date shown on your certificate.
en.legend.save: Tap Save once everything looks correct.
en.step3.title: Find the details on your insurance certificate
en.step3.body: Not sure where to look? Markers 2 and 3 below match the same numbers from the form in step 2.
en.legend.policynum: Policy Number — type this into the Document Number field.
en.legend.certexpiry: Expiration Date — select this same date in the Expiry Date field.
en.step4.title: Save
en.step4.body: Once everything matches, tap Save (marker 4 in step 2). Your FHV Insurance Certificate step is now complete.
en.tips.title: Before you save
en.tips.item1: Make sure the certificate photo is clear, well-lit, and shows all four corners.
en.tips.item2: Double-check that the Policy Number you type matches the certificate exactly, including any letters.
en.tips.item3: Confirm your insurance hasn't expired — you'll need an updated certificate from your insurer first if it has.
en.footer.help: Still having trouble? Contact support from within the app for further assistance.
